cohort: The study included 20 healthy pregnant women and 20 patients suspected of preeclampsia, with mean gestational ages of 39 and 38 weeks respectively, from whom samples were collected before and immediately after delivery.
finding: Preeclampsia is associated with increased prostasin in urine, but not with altered prostasin levels in placenta or plasma at term.
cross-section timing: Samples were collected before delivery and placental biopsies immediately after delivery.
gest_age: Control group: 39 weeks; Preeclampsia group: 38 weeks
